sources: Bruch & Newman (2018). Aspirational pursuit of mates in online dating markets. Science Advances 4(8). One dating site, New York, Boston, Chicago, Seattle; desirability via PageRank-like ranking; most users contact partners ~25% more desirable; ~21% of those pursuing out-of-league get a reply; men's desirability rises with age to ~50, women's declines from 18 to 60. Via Phys.org.
